title: Kinto Cast Iron Teapot 800ml
description_en: A traditional Japanese tetsubin reimagined for modern kitchens. Cast iron retains heat 3× longer than ceramic, and the enamel interior never affects taste. A centerpiece that improves with age.
description_ja: 伝統的な南部鉄器を現代のキッチン向けにデザイン。鉄は陶器の3倍の保温力。琺瑯加工で味に影響せず、使うほど風格が増す逸品。
